cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 w/ Radeon 890M
measurement: Two real scalar functions a/b with N named arithmetic bindings, each specialized once. Separate children for build-only (no query, export or whole-graph restoration) and build+native aa source query (front end/analyzer/HIR retained). Linux wait4 whole-child RSS high water includes startup, front end, Stage, file enumeration, cleanup and query if selected; query RSS is NOT isolated. Census is a separate child with an allocating traversal index and is excluded from build/query distributions. Paths census covers reachable module HIR and binding traces, not analyzer-only retained expressions. Counts Step objects and heap string capacity once; excludes shared_ptr control blocks, allocator overhead and path handles. Raw logical steps measure expanded path length, not allocated strings. IO counters are successful CAS payload reads/writes and file sizes, NOT total syscall/physical disk IO; omit validation reads, failed operations, directory IO. No cold-page claim; warm/repeated children share OS page cache. All runs sequential after builds/tests finish; no core pinning or fixed frequency. Baseline and shared probes differ only in path implementation/adapters, build identity and added opt-in census; census is never run on the old probe. Baseline is preserved from a dirty pre-change tree and identified by full source and binary hashes, not reproducible from the HEAD commit alone.
